summary: This clinical trial is testing a device called transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation for adults who are overweight or have obesity and have not lost enough weight using certain medications. The study will look at the percent change in body weight over a period of 12 weeks. A total of 24 participants will be enrolled to receive either the active device or a sham device along with their medication.
